title: Reject Mediocrity, Embrace Solitude (Take Up Arms Against Apathy w/ The Educated
summary: A short narrated motivational piece using Hajime no Ippo imagery. Every day you choose between excellence and mediocrity; comfort and the crowd breed apathy. Solitude and struggle forge the self, and others' irritation at your separation shows you chose the right path.
claims: Each day is a choice between striving for excellence and mediocrity, and you alone live with the consequences
Struggle tempers the soul; comfort keeps people fat and docile and makes apathy the norm
Excellence requires breaking from the group; people who try to pull you back down only confirm you chose the virtuous path
Time alone is your most valuable asset because it lets you figure out who you are; mediocre people fear solitude because it forces introspection
